title: Do walking, stress, drinking, and education distinguish districts with more adult obesity? (analysis code)
description: Analysis code for a small-area study of self-reported adult obesity across the 229 districts of the Republic of Korea, 2011-2024: pre-model data gate and panel correction, spatiotemporal Fay-Herriot models (R-INLA) with sensitivity analyses, additional analyses, number extraction, maps and figures. Code only; the processed district-year data are not included. All source statistics are public aggregated statistics. Software: R 4.6.0, R-INLA 25.10.19, Python 3.9.6.
